scope: Q10 bounded original-practice MCQ source and distractor-quality audit
question: Which statement about the Gentlemen’s Agreement is most accurate?

existing_options.B: It was intended to safeguard Telangana interests around merger

source.institution: Government of India Ministry of Home Affairs, Committee for Consultations on the Situation in Andhra Pradesh (Srikrishna Committee), 2010 report and Appendix XIV
source.access: Official MHA indexed document text inspected via search; not independently downloaded and page-rendered this cycle

finding: B is supported by the government report; distractors A/C/D are weak and unrelated, so Q10 tests elimination rather than distinguishing specific merger safeguards.

suggested_replacement_not_applied.stem: Which safeguard was specifically included in the 1956 Gentlemen’s Agreement concerning Telangana?
suggested_replacement_not_applied.A: Telangana's remaining regional income after proportional common-administration expenditure would be reserved for its development
suggested_replacement_not_applied.B: All public employment in both regions would be reserved exclusively for Telangana residents
suggested_replacement_not_applied.C: A separate Telangana legislative assembly would replace the united state's legislature immediately
suggested_replacement_not_applied.D: All Telangana agricultural land sales would be prohibited without exception
suggested_replacement_not_applied.caveat: Option A corresponds to Appendix XIV clause 1. Options B-D are counterfactual overstatements; check each against complete agreement text and assess plausible distractor quality before publication.
